lessons_used: Reordering sign-in steps consistently hurt performance across tests.
Finish layout changes consistently hurt performance across tests.
Adoption copy, home redesign, home wait-info, sign-in hints, and sign-in redesign showed no clear effect across tests.
Choose path redesign produced the first winning test (choose_path_card_redesign), though results for that kind of change remain mixed.
Predictions were generally too high across most tests, though pessimistic negative predictions were sometimes inaccurate (e.g., predicting -7.0% for the winning choose_path_card_redesign).

Evidence remains thin for adoption hint, adoption new_flow, adoption new_screen, adoption redesign, choose_path hint, choose_path layout, finish incentive, finish notification, home new_flow, and home new_screen, as each has only 1 test so far.

candidates.title: adoption_photo_preview_confirmation_screen
candidates.change: Add a new confirmation step right after uploading photos so users can inspect and approve photo quality before starting pet generation.
candidates.why: 3 support complaints noted custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, and adoption conversion drops to 60.9%.

new_photo_confirm.headline: Confirm your pet photo
new_photo_confirm.body: Ensure your photo is bright and clearly shows your pet for the best result.

guard.reason: Valid addition of photo confirmation screen inside onboarding flow.

candidates.score_note: High drop step with support complaints, but extra screen requires release and has limited precedent.

candidates.title: pick_friend_grid_redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the companion selection screen into a responsive visual grid layout featuring avatar cards.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel at 60.9% with a high median time of 89s.

guard.reason: replacement for 'pick_friend.pet_choices' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: finish_desktop_launch_new_flow
candidates.change: Introduce a guided launch walkthrough on the final screen showing where the pet lands on the desktop and how to summon it.
candidates.why: Support receives messages about pets not showing on desktop, and finish stage conversion drops to 64.8%.

components.text: 1. Look at your bottom right dock. 2. Click pet icon to summon or hide.

guard.reason: Valid walkthrough components added to home intro.

candidates.score_note: Finish step loses over 35% and support emails confirm issue, but new flow is high cost.

candidates.title: choose_path_preview_new_screen
candidates.change: Insert a short teaser preview screen before choosing a path to demonstrate desktop pet behaviors live.
candidates.why: 23.4% of users drop off at choose_path in median 8 seconds; showcasing app capabilities early boosts intent.

new_app_teaser.headline: Meet Your Future Desktop Buddy
new_app_teaser.body: Your companion lives directly on your wallpaper, reacts to your clicks, and keeps you company while you work.

guard.reason: Valid addition of desktop pet preview screen before choosing path.

candidates.score_note: Choose path drop-off is early but lacks support mail evidence; new screen has high build cost.

candidates.title: sign_in_existing_account_warning_copy
candidates.change: Update sign-in headline and body to explicitly warn returning users to sign in with their original account.
candidates.why: 8 support emails (the top support issue) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again with a secondary method.

sign_in.headline: Sign in to keep your existing pets
sign_in.body: Be sure to use the same email or social account you used previously so your saved pets load automatically.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.body' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: upload_photo_quality_tip_hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit photo quality tip on the photo upload screen explaining lighting and pose requirements.
candidates.why: Adoption fails frequently and support receives complaints about custom pet generation looking wrong.

upload_photos.hint: Tip: Well-lit frontal photos with a single clear subject produce the best results.

guard.reason: Valid photo quality hint added to photo upload screen.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence and cheap to add, but hints in adoption step previously hurt conversion.

candidates.title: waiting_estimated_time_progress_info
candidates.change: Show dynamic estimated remaining time and rotating tips during the generation waiting phase.
candidates.why: Home waiting step takes a median of 201s (mean 2336s), causing drop-offs while users wait blindly.

guard.reason: Valid real time estimate and tips added to waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Solves extreme wait time friction; home wait_info historically yielded consistent +1.5% lift.

candidates.title: adoption_certificate_custom_name_incentive
candidates.change: Offer an unlocked custom identity badge component upon filling out the adoption certificate.
candidates.why: Adoption has a high drop-off rate (60.9% conversion); rewarding completion encourages users to finish.

adoption_certificate.headline: Name Your Desktop Companion
adoption_certificate.body: Give your pet a special name to unlock their custom identity badge!

guard.reason: The adoption certificate loses its required official stamp.

candidates.title: home_intro_desktop_ready_notification
candidates.change: Enable desktop notification prompt on the finish screen so users know when the pet is active.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets noted pets not showing or users not realizing the app opened successfully after setup.

home_intro.hint: We will show a quick system notification once your pet is ready on your desktop.

guard.reason: Valid addition of desktop ready notification prompt to home intro.

candidates.score_note: Backed by support tickets on finish stage; past notification test yielded mild positive lift.

candidates.title: story_welcome_quick_overview_hint
candidates.change: Add a reassuring setup duration hint to the story welcome screen.
candidates.why: Choose path drops over 23% of users; setting expectation of a fast 2-minute setup lowers friction.

story.hint: Quick Setup: Pick and personalize your desktop companion in under 2 minutes!

guard.reason: Valid setup time estimate hint added to story screen.

candidates.score_note: Low effort config hint for early step drop-off; aligned with +0.2% past choose_path hint test.

lessons_next: Reordering sign-in steps and changing finish layouts consistently hurt performance across tests.
Adoption new screens, choose-path hints, and choose-path redesigns proved helpful by producing winning tests.
Adoption copy, home redesign, home wait-info, sign-in hints, and sign-in redesign showed no clear effect across tests.
Predictions were generally too high across most tests, though pessimistic negative predictions were sometimes inaccurate for winning tests.

Evidence remains thin for kinds of change tested only once (adoption hint, adoption new_flow, adoption redesign, choose_path layout, finish incentive, finish new_flow, finish notification, home new_flow, and home new_screen).
